label: main season
summary: E1 is an indirect, unchecked national database record of a past accident inside the area (reliability class 6). The national criteria make this record a clearance target after the first NTS visit, and technical survey is unavailable. E2 is not evidence because the informant does not know the land inside the area.
flags: The database record's date, detail and location have not been checked on the ground; the criteria nevertheless require an intrusive check before release.
Zone flag and survey priority indicate where to survey and are not evidence.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: The database record's location and reliability have not been checked on the ground, so it suggests possible EO presence but does not confirm it.

E2.quote: A bus driver said he only passes along the road at the edge of the area and does not know the land inside it.
E2.note: The informant explicitly does not know the land inside the area, so this statement neither supports EO presence nor absence.
